title: How far outstandR's G-computation estimate moves across target reconstructions
question: How much does outstandR's G-computation estimate depend on how it reconstructs the aggregate trial's covariate distribution from published means and SDs, when the true covariates are skewed and tail-dependent?
design: Skewed target covariates with a Clayton or Gaussian copula, IPD with the same or a different correlation; outstandR's G-computation under five reconstructions (default, reported correlation, independence, gamma margins); anchored binary-outcome comparison. 4 cells, 400 replicates each.
